mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, period_start, period_end, summary FROM t_health_analysis WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_health_analysis (user_id, period_start, period_end, summary) VALUES (#{userId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{summary})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_health_analysis SET user_id=#{userId}, period_start=#{periodStart}, period_end=#{periodEnd}, summary=#{summary} WHERE id=#{id}
